# Robot Catalog — full catalog

> Every robot in Robot Catalog (1004) with its core specs and sources, in one file. Values are as the maker publishes them; fields the maker does not publish are left out rather than estimated.

- Canonical site: https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/
- Index for agents: https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/llms.txt
- Per-robot Markdown with the full spec sheet and a source on every value: https://htcrefactor.github.io/robot-catalog/md/<id>.md
- Generated from data/robots.json, last merged 2026-11-25. No scoring, no ranking.
